summary: CREDIT-CONTROL VERIFICATION SWEEP for mobile quick-nav rollout. Full visual + UX sweep at 390px and 1280px across all customer pages, plus admin/staff regression. All 9 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS. Zero JS console errors, zero warnings, zero regressions found. NO code changes made.

verification_matrix.3_active_pill_highlighting: PASS — / → الرئيسية active, /tickets → تذاكر بالساعة active, /birthday → حفلات أعياد الميلاد active, /subscriptions → الاشتراكات active, /profile (auth) → حجوزاتي active. /groups & /home-party correctly have no active pill (not part of quick-nav set, expected). حجوزاتي pill appears ONLY for authenticated non-admin/non-staff (verified: 4 pills logged-out → 5 pills after parent login).
verification_matrix.4_horizontal_scroll_rtl_no_wrap_scrollba: PASS — overflow-x:auto, flex-wrap:nowrap, scrollbar hidden. With 5 pills (auth) scrollWidth=567 > clientWidth=366 → scrollable. With 4 pills (logged out) scrollWidth=479 > clientWidth=366 → still scrollable (track also has soft fade ::before).
verification_matrix.5_no_overlap_with_headings_or_navbar: PASS — on /, strip occupies y=122–183, first H1 ('حيث يلعب الأطفال ويحتفلون') at y=314 → ~130px clear gap. No clipping on tickets/birthday/subscriptions either (visible in screenshots). Sticky navbar logo + hamburger + auth buttons render above strip without overlap.
verification_matrix.6_desktop_legacy_3pill_nav_intact_1280px: PASS — .desktop-nav-links renders exactly 3 pills on every customer page; sky-theme background visible; no layout shifts.
verification_matrix.7_admin_staff_regression: PASS — after admin@peekaboo.com login, mobile-quick-nav-strip is NOT in DOM on /admin, /staff, /reception (isCustomerNav=false short-circuits render).
verification_matrix.8_console_errors_warnings: PASS — 0 console errors, 0 console warnings across all customer page navigations.
verification_matrix.9_spacing_profile_booking_confirmation_p: PASS — /profile (post parent login) renders with no double-top-padding; strip sits naturally below navbar header. /booking-confirmation reachable directly and renders strip with no spacing break.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (informational, NOT a regression): the soft fade ::before pseudo-element only targets [dir='rtl'] .mobile-quick-nav-strip. If the app ever toggles to LTR the fade hint disappears. App is Arabic-first so non-blocking.

Minor (informational): /groups and /home-party are customer routes that show the strip but have no matching pill, so no pill is active on those pages. If the product expects an 'active' indicator for every customer page, those routes would need to be added to mobileQuickNavItems or grouped under an existing pill. Not flagged as a regression because the current navItems list is intentionally restricted to the 4 primary buying destinations + home + (auth) bookings.
test_credentials: parent@peekaboo.com / parent123, admin@peekaboo.com / admin123 (sourced from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, both worked first-try)
seed_data_creation: None — pure visual/UX sweep, no data mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile quick-nav strip ships clean. Selectors for future regression: outer strip = [data-testid='mobile-quick-nav-strip'], inner pills = [data-testid='mobile-nav-home'|'mobile-nav-tickets'|'mobile-nav-birthday'|'mobile-nav-subscriptions'|'mobile-nav-profile']. The strip is gated by isCustomerNav (!isAdmin && !isStaff) AND md:hidden — both must be true to render visibly. Track = .mobile-quick-nav-track (overflow-x:auto, scroll-snap-type:x proximity). Auth state changes the pill count from 4 → 5 (adds حجوزاتي). RTL fade overlay is via [dir='rtl'] .mobile-quick-nav-strip::before.
